scope: Official microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T packed native BitNet checkpoint, evaluated through Transformers 4.57.6 native BitNet support. Post-decoder-layer residual-stream A4 geometry intervention only; this does not replace the model's internal BitLinear W1.58A8 quantization.

protocol.runtime: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 CPU; torch 2.13.0+cpu; transformers 4.57.6

preregistered_rules.replication: angularH A4 + true token radius NLL < matched Hadamard per-token absmax A4 NLL
preregistered_rules.radial_specificity: true-radius NLL + 0.25 <= min(shifted-radius NLL, constant-radius NLL)

interpretation.supported: On this frozen 1016-token native BitNet screen, preserving the correct token-specific residual RMS while quantizing the normalized/Hadamard-mixed direction to a fixed A4 grid materially outperformed a matched Hadamard per-token dynamic A4 baseline, and it outperformed shifted and constant-radius controls.
interpretation.not_yet_supported: This does not yet show that a new fixed angular code is necessary, that a low-bit radius codec works, that A3/A2 is viable, or that the effect survives a baseline that performs ordinary Hadamard dynamic A4 and then restores the exact pre-quantization RMS.
interpretation.next_hostile_control: Compare Hadamard dynamic A4 with exact RMS restoration against fixed-grid angular A4 with exact radius under the same frozen protocol. If RMS-restored dynamic A4 closes the gap, the contribution is radial preservation rather than the fixed angular code.
